product.title: Cabo San Lucas Sunset Sailing Shared Cruise

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this two-hour shared sunset sail boards a yacht for Land's End and the Arch while the crew talks through local coastline history. Unlimited beer, wine, and soft drinks are served with snacks so the evening stays on deck rather than a separate bar stop. Departure time tracks the sunset, and the boat often powers down to sail once it clears the rocks. Hotel pickup is not included; the published meeting point is the marina dock listed at booking. The format suits visitors who want a guided scenic sail without chartering independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the marina, Arch, and Land's End that shape this evening cruise.

highlights: Set out on a relaxing and informative sunset sailing cruise off Los Cabos
Board a luxury yacht for a 2-hour evening excursion, watching the sun slowly disappear below the horizon while listening
An expert crew will regale you with facts and history about the area as your boat makes its way smoothly across the sea
